rows.text: What's the Pixel offer up, a extremely clean version of Android, they say there is some app's, I haven't looked really close, but short of Hacking the phone this may be the cleanest version of Android ever from Verizon. What's this mean, fast, no NO lag, you know how sometimes you flip the screen and sometimes it flips and sometimes it doesn't or sometimes it just sit's and does nothing, that's irritating lag, all those cool and fancy things on the Samsung contribute to that, the phone can lag, apps won't open/close, you push buttons and nothing happens, not so with the Pixel at least not up to now after 3 day's of playing with it.

It may be last year's phone, but it's still current and affordable!. I've now had it for nearly two months and it just seems perfect. It's fast, comfortable, and has extremely good battery life. And it has enough RAM that I can run Pokemon Go and switch out to send a text or take a phone, and the app stays running. My old phone (Nexus 5X) would restart the app.

Lastly, the GPS performance has been sub par. I have the same service I had with my Iphone, but when I use run tracking apps, the data is completely wrong, only tracking parts of the run and giving highly inaccurate data (for example, a 1.5 mile route logs as .7 miles). I do love the picture quality, but am not sure I made the right choice.
A literal STEAL of a bundle. I love this bundle and the phone. The phone is SO smooth and doesn’t lag ever. It’s amazing.

This Phone Blows Every Other Android Phone out of the Water. The Google Pixel functions more smoothly than any Android phone I have used before. None of the animations are choppy, scrolling is always perfectly smooth, 60 FPS. One of my favorite features of this phone is that because it is designed and branded by Google, it gets Android updates the minute they are released—no having to wait months or in some cases, years, to get Android updates. The user interface is perfect. By default, there is no ugly Samsung TouchWiz or HTC Sense launchers that look gross or slow down the phone—it is pure Google Android—the way Google envisioned Android to be. The camera is fantastic, my pictures look great. The thing I like most though is that Google gives you unlimited high-resolution Google Photo storage space with photos taken with the Pixel. The camera app is also one of the best camera apps on any phone.
Great phones, extremely smooth user experience. Great phones, extremely smooth user experience. Way much better than the other Android flagships if you are a software-oriented guy.

Love the performance and build! Goodbye Samsung!. Better than any Samsung I've owned! Every Samsung phone I've owned became sluggish over time. Pixel 3 is running as lightning fast as it was on day one! I love the dual front facing speakers for when I don't feel like connecting/plugging in headphones. Letting the device ‘take a break’ from use or limiting/turning off features (even those running in the background) could remedy the situation. Here are some tips/suggestions: Media apps (music, video games sad Close or turn off other apps and features that you're not using; they may be running in the background. Discontinue using the media temporarily until the temperature normalizes. User-installed apps: Put the device in safe mode to disable 3rd party apps and see if the issue improves. Try uninstalling recently installed apps to pinpoint the app causing the issue. Display brightness: Manually setting the brightness to be very bright may contribute to higher device temperature. Consider setting to auto brightness or manually reducing the brightness setting. GPS / 3G / WiFi - prolonged data connectivity: Turn off feature when not in use. Stop or limit use and allow device to cool down if it gets warm.

Set data alerts and limits + monitor apps running in background unless you have unlimited data plan. Got this for my 20-something daughter at Verizon store very early in July. She still loves, loves, loves it and would give it 5 stars. However, her data usage went from under 2 gigs to over 7 the first month she used it because of default settings allowing so many apps to run in the background, and because of the phone's reluctance to connect to anything less than optimal, super-perfect wi-fi signals.

Samsung phones do. Samsung lets you group all Verizon apps, all Google apps, all games, etc. Pixel 3 has one giant dogpile of all apps in alphabetical order. Have fun! 5. GPS is extremely buggy. Tried to track my steps with Samsung Health, which I used for years on my Samsung S7, and suddenly it had me teleporting all over the place on my map track. Never once had this happen on my old phone. Navigating with my phone in Google Maps is a primary use for my smartphone; this is unforgivable. I've only had this a week, and I hate it already. The only reason I'm going to live with it is that it was affordable, and I purchased the 2 year extended warranty, so if the camera/microphone/battery/whatever dies like some other reviewers report, I can remedy that for less than a new phone costs.

It has ~2 days battery life on one charge, and that's with my screen is on a good portion of the time. Overall the phone is super responsive and can run smoothly no matter how many apps I open and forget to close(big upgrade over my huawei honor 5x, which as of a week or so ago when I got this phone, was chugging with JUST google maps open). Camera quality is phenomenal, one of the best cameras(not phone cameras mind you) I've used, period, it has fantastic picture quality and the colors are much more true to life than my last phone(honor 5x). It does good with white balancing, so I've not had any washed out or overly dark pictures. I never used google assistant before, outside of a little messing around with my old phone years ago, and I can say that since then it's really improved.

Great phone. Was hesitant on getting this phone but after having it for a while the battery life is quite good and I haven't had any issues at all with the phone features/functionality. Slightly lighter than the original pixel and the phone is about identical in size but has a larger and better display. The phone is extremely quick loading web pages and scrolls very smoothly and fast through screens and when moving between apps. I also had the 3A and this phone is definitely smoother and with a better feel. Also it's water resistant which the 3A is not. I dropped the 3A in water for less than 2 seconds and it was ruined. First time I did that with a phone but not a worry with the pixel 3.
Great Phone. It is a great phone, and the price is good too. It runs stock Android and runs smoothly. Hardware is great too excluding the bezels.
